fine_lines.title: aunt / uncle vs Arabic عم وخال
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الإنجليزية تستخدم كلمة واحدة لكل جانب: uncle للعم والخال، و aunt للعمة والخالة. لتحديد الجهة نقول: my father's brother (عمي)، my mother's sister (خالتي).
fine_lines.explanation_en: English has one word for both sides of the family: uncle and aunt. To be exact, say my father's brother or my mother's sister.

examples.sentence: Uncle John is my father's brother.
Aunt Lavender is my mom's sister.

fine_lines.title: niece vs nephew
fine_lines.explanation_ar: niece هي ابنة أخيك أو أختك، و nephew هو ابن أخيك أو أختك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Your niece is your brother's or sister's daughter. Your nephew is their son.

examples.sentence: My brother's daughter is my niece.
My sister's son is my nephew.

fine_lines.title: son vs sun
fine_lines.explanation_ar: تُنطقان بالطريقة نفسها. son = الابن، sun = الشمس.
fine_lines.explanation_en: They sound the same. Son = male child; sun = the star in the sky.

grammar.title: Possessive 's (my father's brother)
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) نضيف 's إلى الاسم لنبيّن الملكية أو العلاقة: Anna's family = عائلة آنا.
٢) الترتيب عكس العربية: المالك أولًا ثم الشيء: my mom's sister = أخت أمي.
٣) إذا كان الاسم جمعًا ينتهي بـ s نضيف ' فقط: my parents' house.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) Add 's to a noun to show who owns something or a family link: Anna's family.
2) The owner comes first: my mom's sister.
3) For a plural ending in s, add only ': my parents' house.
examples: Uncle John is my father's brother.
Aunt Lavender is my mom's sister.

grammar.title: Possessive adjectives: my, your, his, her, their
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) my (لي)، your (لك)، his (له)، her (لها)، its (له لغير العاقل)، our (لنا)، their (لهم).
٢) تأتي قبل الاسم ولا تتغير مع الجمع: my cousins.
٣) his للمذكر و her للمؤنث حسب المالك، لا حسب الشيء.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) my, your, his, her, its, our, their.
2) They come before the noun and don't change for plural: my cousins.
3) His or her depends on the owner, not on the thing.
examples: They are my Uncle John's daughter and son.

grammar.title: Simple present: What does he do?
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) نسأل عن العمل بـ What do/does ... do?
٢) مع he/she نستخدم does، والفعل بعدها بلا s: What does she do?
٣) في الإجابة نضيف s للفعل مع he/she: She makes spoons. They raise sheep.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) Ask about jobs with What do/does ... do?
2) With he/she use does; the verb after it has no s: What does she do?
3) In the answer, add s for he/she: She makes spoons. They raise sheep.
examples: What does your uncle do? He makes chairs.
What do rodeo clowns do? They make people laugh.
